item.title: LOT-109: reho.st Referer follows capture #134
item.body:
Closes #328
Refs #200
Claim: mac/m2-lead

LOT-109 review against capture #134.

**Problem**: the viewer's full-resolution fetch sent `Referer: https://forum.hardware.fr` (legacy value, no trailing slash). The capture (`T30`-`T33`, real image, `https` and `http`) shows 403 without `Referer` and 200 `image/jpeg` with `https://forum.hardware.fr/`; the no-slash form was only seen working on a path naming no file (`T24`).

**Change**: `ImageHostTable.forumReferer` gets the trailing slash (the captured value). Tests updated accordingly. Specs LOT-109, LOT-056 ("Pending capture") and HFR-PROTOCOL §6c updated. No CHANGELOG-LEGACY row: not user-visible. Not observed and noted: `https://reho.st/self/<hash>.jpg` (the app upgrades http to https).

**Tests**: `ReaderImageFetcherTests.theViewerFetchSendsTheRefererTheCaptureRequires` (T30/T31, T32/T33) reads the metas, serves 403/200 per the recorded Referer; passes, and fails with the no-slash value (run locally). HFRNetworkTests (168) and ReaderImageFetcherTests/ReaderImageViewerBridgeTests pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Image requests to `reho.st` now send the forum address as the referrer, including its trailing slash. This matches the verified format for full-resolution images.
  * Requests use HTTPS and omit cookies; images can be fetched successfully with the referrer, while requests without it may be denied.

* **Documentation**
  * Updated image-host guidance with the verified referrer format and observed responses: access denied without a referrer and a successful JPEG response with it.
